import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

/-! ### Option Int as "Int with infinity" -/

def leO (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

theorem leO_none_right (a : Option Int) : leO a none := by
  intro y hy
  exact absurd hy (by simp)

theorem leO_some_some {x y : Int} : leO (some x) (some y) ↔ x ≤ y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h y rfl
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hz
    omega
  · intro h y' hy'
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hy'
    exact ⟨x, rfl, by omega⟩

theorem leO_none_some {y : Int} : ¬ leO none (some y) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := h y rfl
  simp at hx

theorem leO_refl (a : Option Int) : leO a a := by
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

theorem leO_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b c) : leO a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := h1 x hx
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_trans hzx hxy⟩

theorem leO_antisymm {a b : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b a) : a = b := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some y => exact absurd h1 leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact absurd h2 leO_none_some
    | some y =>
      rw [leO_some_some] at h1
      rw [leO_some_some] at h2
      have : x = y := le_antisymm h1 h2
      rw [this]

def minO (a b : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match a, b with
  | none, b => b
  | some x, none => some x
  | some x, some y => some (min x y)

theorem minO_le_left (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) a := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_none_right _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_refl _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some x)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_left x y

theorem minO_le_right (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_refl _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_none_right _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some y)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_right x y

theorem minO_cases (a b : Option Int) : minO a b = a ∨ minO a b = b := by
  cases a with
  | none => right; rfl
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => left; rfl
    | some y =>
      rcases le_total x y with h | h
      · left
        show some (min x y) = some x
        rw [min_eq_left h]
      · right
        show some (min x y) = some y
        rw [min_eq_right h]

def addO (a : Option Int) (w : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (x + w)

theorem addO_le {a : Option Int} {y w : Int} (h : leO a (some y)) :
    leO (addO a w) (some (y + w)) := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact absurd h leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    rw [leO_some_some] at h
    show leO (some (x + w)) (some (y + w))
    rw [leO_some_some]
    omega

theorem addO_some {a : Option Int} {w z : Int} (h : addO a w = some z) :
    ∃ x, a = some x ∧ z = x + w := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    have hc : (none : Option Int) = some z := h
    exact absurd hc (by simp)
  | some x =>
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hc : some (x + w) = some z := h
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hc
    omega

/-! ### folding a minimum -/

def foldMin (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  l.foldl (fun acc pr => minO acc (f pr)) init

theorem foldMin_cons (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (a : Nat × Int) (l : List (Nat × Int))
    (init : Option Int) : foldMin f (a :: l) init = foldMin f l (minO init (f a)) := rfl

theorem foldMin_le_init (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int), leO (foldMin f l init) init := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; exact leO_refl _
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    exact leO_trans (ih _) (minO_le_left _ _)

theorem foldMin_le_mem (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) (pr : Nat × Int), pr ∈ l →
      leO (foldMin f l init) (f pr) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init pr h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init pr h
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h2
    · subst h1
      exact leO_trans (foldMin_le_init f t _) (minO_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih _ pr h2

theorem foldMin_cases (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int),
      foldMin f l init = init ∨ ∃ pr, pr ∈ l ∧ foldMin f l init = f pr := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases ih (minO init (f a)) with h | ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
    · rcases minO_cases init (f a) with h2 | h2
      · left; rw [h, h2]
      · right; exact ⟨a, by simp, by rw [h, h2]⟩
    · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], h⟩

/-! ### tabulation -/

def tab (f : Nat → Option Int) (i : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f i :: tab f (i + 1) k

theorem tab_length (f : Nat → Option Int) : ∀ (k i : Nat), (tab f i k).length = k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i
    show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).length = k + 1
    rw [List.length_cons, ih]

theorem tab_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (k i v : Nat), v < k → (tab f i k).getD v none = f (i + v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i v h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v h
    cases v with
    | zero =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD 0 none = f (i + 0)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ m =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD (m + 1) none = f (i + (m + 1))
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ, ih (i + 1) m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega

/-! ### list helpers -/

theorem my_eq_nil_or_concat {α : Type} : ∀ (l : List α), l = [] ∨ ∃ L b, l = L ++ [b] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    right
    rcases ih with h | ⟨L, b, h⟩
    · exact ⟨[], a, by simp [h]⟩
    · exact ⟨a :: L, b, by rw [h]; simp⟩

theorem snoc_of_getLast {α : Type} (l : List α) (v : α) (h : l.getLast? = some v) :
    ∃ q, l = q ++ [v] := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l with hn | ⟨L, b, hL⟩
  · rw [hn] at h; simp at h
  · rw [hL] at h
    simp only [List.getLast?_concat, Option.some.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨L, by rw [hL, h]⟩

theorem head?_append_ne_nil {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l1 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).head? = l1.head? := by
  cases l1 with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t => simp

theorem getLast?_append_right {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l2 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).getLast? = l2.getLast? := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l2 with h0 | ⟨q, v, hq⟩
  · exact absurd h0 h
  · subst hq
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    simp

theorem list_ext_getD : ∀ (l1 l2 : List (Option Int)), l1.length = l2.length →
    (∀ v, v < l1.length → l1.getD v none = l2.getD v none) → l1 = l2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro l2 hl _
    cases l2 with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t => simp at hl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 hl h
    cases l2 with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons b t2 =>
      have h0 := h 0 (by simp)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_zero] at h0
      subst h0
      have hlen : t.length = t2.length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
        omega
      have hrest : t = t2 := by
        refine ih t2 hlen ?_
        intro v hv
        have hv' : v + 1 < (a :: t).length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        have hx := h (v + 1) hv'
        rw [List.getD_cons_succ, List.getD_cons_succ] at hx
        exact hx
      rw [hrest]

theorem nodup_length_le (p : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hnd : p.Nodup) (hlt : ∀ x ∈ p, x < n) :
    p.length ≤ n := by
  have hsub : p ⊆ List.range n := by
    intro x hx
    exact List.mem_range.mpr (hlt x hx)
  have h := List.Subperm.length_le (List.subperm_of_subset hnd hsub)
  simpa using h

theorem dup_decomp : ∀ (p : List Nat), ¬ p.Nodup →
    ∃ (A B C : List Nat) (x : Nat), p = A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd List.nodup_nil h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    by_cases hat : a ∈ t
    · obtain ⟨B, C, hBC⟩ := List.append_of_mem hat
      exact ⟨[], B, C, a, by simp [hBC]⟩
    · have hnd : ¬ t.Nodup := by
        intro hc
        exact h (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hat, hc⟩)
      obtain ⟨A, B, C, x, hp⟩ := ih hnd
      exact ⟨a :: A, B, C, x, by simp [hp]⟩

/-! ### basic path facts -/

theorem phw_nil (g : WeightedGraph) (w : Int) : g.path_has_weight [] w ↔ w = 0 := Iff.rfl

theorem phw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight [x] w ↔ w = 0 := Iff.rfl

theorem phw_cons (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (u :: v :: rest) w ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge u v we ∧ g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) wr ∧ w = we + wr := Iff.rfl

theorem isPath_single (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) : g.is_path [x] := ⟨by simp, trivial⟩

theorem isPath_cons_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) :
    g.is_path (u :: v :: rest) ↔ ((∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, h⟩; exact h
  · intro h; exact ⟨by simp, h⟩

theorem isPath_of_phw (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int),
    p ≠ [] → g.path_has_weight p w → g.is_path p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h _; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro w _ hw
    cases t with
    | nil => exact isPath_single g u
    | cons v rest =>
      rw [phw_cons] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, _⟩ := hw
      exact (isPath_cons_iff g u v rest).mpr ⟨⟨we, hedge⟩, ih wr (by simp) hrest⟩

theorem phw_of_isPath (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, (phw_nil g 0).mpr rfl⟩
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro hp
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl⟩
    | cons v rest =>
      obtain ⟨⟨we, hedge⟩, hrest⟩ := (isPath_cons_iff g u v rest).mp hp
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih hrest
      exact ⟨we + wr, (phw_cons g u v rest _).mpr ⟨we, wr, hedge, hwr, rfl⟩⟩

theorem phw_append_mid (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) (w : Int),
      g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ x :: l2) w ↔
        ∃ w1 w2, g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ [x]) w1 ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧
          w = w1 + w2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro x l2 w
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨0, w, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, h, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
      have hw1 : w1 = 0 := (phw_single g x w1).mp h1
      subst hw1
      have hz : (0 : Int) + w2 = w2 := by omega
      rw [hz]
      exact h2
  | cons a l1' ih =>
    intro x l2 w
    cases l1' with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        refine ⟨we, wr, ?_, hrest, hw⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw1⟩ := h1
        have hz : wr = 0 := (phw_single g x wr).mp hrest
        exact (phw_cons g a x l2 _).mpr ⟨we, w2, hedge, h2, by omega⟩
    | cons b l1'' =>
      have ihx : ∀ (ww : Int), g.path_has_weight (b :: (l1'' ++ x :: l2)) ww ↔
          ∃ w1 w2, g.path_has_weight (b :: (l1'' ++ [x])) w1 ∧
            g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧ ww = w1 + w2 := by
        intro ww
        have h := ih x l2 ww
        simpa only [List.cons_append] using h
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [ihx] at hrest
        obtain ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, hwr⟩ := hrest
        refine ⟨we + w1, w2, ?_, h2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a b (l1'' ++ [x]) _).mpr ⟨we, w1, hedge, h1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw1⟩ := h1
        refine (phw_cons g a b (l1'' ++ x :: l2) _).mpr ⟨we, wr + w2, hedge, ?_, by omega⟩
        rw [ihx]
        exact ⟨wr, w2, hrest, h2, rfl⟩

theorem phw_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (u x : Nat) (w : Int),
    g.path_has_weight (q ++ [u, x]) w ↔
      ∃ w1 we, g.path_has_weight (q ++ [u]) w1 ∧ g.has_edge u x we ∧ w = w1 + we := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
    intro u x w
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [phw_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
      have hz : wr = 0 := (phw_single g x wr).mp hrest
      exact ⟨0, we, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl, hedge, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
      have hz : w1 = 0 := (phw_single g u w1).mp h1
      exact (phw_cons g u x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
  | cons a q' ih =>
    intro u x w
    cases q' with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [phw_cons] at hrest
        obtain ⟨we2, wr2, hedge2, hrest2, hw2⟩ := hrest
        have hz : wr2 = 0 := (phw_single g x wr2).mp hrest2
        refine ⟨we, we2, ?_, hedge2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a u [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we1, wr1, hedge1, hrest1, hw1⟩ := h1
        have hz : wr1 = 0 := (phw_single g u wr1).mp hrest1
        refine (phw_cons g a u [x] _).mpr ⟨we1, we, hedge1, ?_, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g u x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
    | cons b q'' =>
      have ihx : ∀ (ww : Int), g.path_has_weight (b :: (q'' ++ [u, x])) ww ↔
          ∃ w1 we, g.path_has_weight (b :: (q'' ++ [u])) w1 ∧ g.has_edge u x we ∧
            ww = w1 + we := by
        intro ww
        have h := ih u x ww
        simpa only [List.cons_append] using h
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [ihx] at hrest
        obtain ⟨w1, we2, h1, hedge2, hwr⟩ := hrest
        refine ⟨we + w1, we2, ?_, hedge2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a b (q'' ++ [u]) _).mpr ⟨we, w1, hedge, h1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we1, wr1, hedge1, hrest1, hw1⟩ := h1
        refine (phw_cons g a b (q'' ++ [u, x]) _).mpr ⟨we1, wr1 + we, hedge1, ?_, by omega⟩
        rw [ihx]
        exact ⟨wr1, we, hrest1, hedge, rfl⟩

theorem phw_mem_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), g.path_has_weight p w → 2 ≤ p.length →
      ∀ x ∈ p, x < g.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w _ h; simp at h
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro w hw hlen x hx
    cases t with
    | nil => exact absurd hlen (by simp)
    | cons v rest =>
      rw [phw_cons] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, _⟩ := hw
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hxu | hx'
      · rw [hxu]; exact hedge.1
      · cases rest with
        | nil =>
          have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx'
          rw [hxv]
          obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, hp1, hp2⟩ := hedge
          have hlt := (hwf u hu).1 pair hpair
          rw [hp1] at hlt
          exact hlt
        | cons c rest' =>
          exact ih wr hrest (by simp) x hx'

/-! ### the algorithm -/

def inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filterMap
      (fun pr => if pr.1 = v then some (u, pr.2) else none)))

theorem arr_mem_toList {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr.toList ↔ a ∈ arr := by
  simp

theorem mem_inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v u : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u', hu', pr, hpr, hif⟩ := h
    by_cases hc : pr.1 = v
    · rw [if_pos hc] at hif
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hif
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hif
      subst h1
      exact ⟨hu', pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mp hpr, hc, h2⟩
    · rw [if_neg hc] at hif
      exact absurd hif (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, h2⟩
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨u, hu, pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mpr hpr, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos h1, h2]

def bestAt (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  foldMin (fun pr => addO (d.getD pr.1 none) pr.2) (inEdges g v) (d.getD v none)

def stepD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  tab (fun v => bestAt g d v) 0 g.size

def iterD (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => tab (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none) 0 g.size
  | k + 1 => stepD g (iterD g start k)

theorem stepD_length (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) :
    (stepD g d).length = g.size := tab_length _ _ _

theorem iterD_length (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ k, (iterD g start k).length = g.size := by
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero => exact tab_length _ _ _
  | succ k => exact tab_length _ _ _

theorem stepD_getD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (stepD g d).getD v none = bestAt g d v := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => bestAt g d v) g.size 0 v hv
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

theorem iterD_zero_getD (g : WeightedGraph) (start v : Nat) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (iterD g start 0).getD v none = (if v = start then some 0 else none) := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none) g.size 0 v hv
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

theorem bestAt_le_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    leO (bestAt g d v) (d.getD v none) := foldMin_le_init _ _ _

theorem bestAt_le_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : leO (bestAt g d v) (addO (d.getD u none) w) := by
  have hmem : (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v := (mem_inEdges g v u w).mpr h
  exact foldMin_le_mem _ _ _ _ hmem

theorem bestAt_cases (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    bestAt g d v = d.getD v none ∨
      ∃ u w, g.has_edge u v w ∧ bestAt g d v = addO (d.getD u none) w := by
  rcases foldMin_cases (fun pr => addO (d.getD pr.1 none) pr.2) (inEdges g v)
      (d.getD v none) with h | ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
  · left; exact h
  · right
    refine ⟨pr.1, pr.2, (mem_inEdges g v pr.1 pr.2).mp ?_, h⟩
    simpa using hpr

/-! ### soundness and completeness of the iteration -/

theorem iterD_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (x : Int), v < g.size → (iterD g start k).getD v none = some x →
      ∃ q, g.path_has_weight (q ++ [v]) x ∧ (q ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v x hv h
    rw [iterD_zero_getD g start v hv] at h
    by_cases hvs : v = start
    · rw [if_pos hvs] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      refine ⟨[], ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.nil_append]
        exact (phw_single g v x).mpr h.symm
      · simp [hvs]
    · rw [if_neg hvs] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v x hv h
    have hstep : (iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none = bestAt g (iterD g start k) v :=
      stepD_getD g (iterD g start k) v hv
    rw [hstep] at h
    rcases bestAt_cases g (iterD g start k) v with hc | ⟨u, w, hedge, hc⟩
    · rw [hc] at h
      exact ih v x hv h
    · rw [hc] at h
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := addO_some h
      have hu : u < g.size := hedge.1
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hhead⟩ := ih u y hu hy
      refine ⟨q ++ [u], ?_, ?_⟩
      · have heq : (q ++ [u]) ++ [v] = q ++ [u, v] := by simp
        rw [heq]
        exact (phw_snoc g q u v x).mpr ⟨y, w, hq, hedge, by omega⟩
      · rw [head?_append_ne_nil _ _ (by simp)]
        exact hhead

theorem iterD_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat),
      g.path_has_weight p w → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some v →
      p.length ≤ k + 1 → leO ((iterD g start k).getD v none) (some w) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p w v hw hhead hlast hlen
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd hhead (by simp)
    | cons a t =>
      cases t with
      | nil =>
        have ha : a = start := by simpa using hhead
        have hav : a = v := by simpa using hlast
        have hw0 : w = 0 := (phw_single g a w).mp hw
        have hvs : v = start := by omega
        rw [hvs, iterD_zero_getD g start start hstart, if_pos rfl, hw0]
        exact leO_refl _
      | cons b t' => exact absurd hlen (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p w v hw hhead hlast hlen
    have hv : v < g.size := by
      obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ := snoc_of_getLast p v hlast
      cases p with
      | nil => exact absurd hhead (by simp)
      | cons a t =>
        cases t with
        | nil =>
          have ha : a = start := by simpa using hhead
          have hav : a = v := by simpa using hlast
          omega
        | cons b t' =>
          refine phw_mem_lt g hwf _ w hw (by simp) v ?_
          rw [hq0]
          simp
    have hstep : (iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none = bestAt g (iterD g start k) v :=
      stepD_getD g (iterD g start k) v hv
    by_cases hle : p.length ≤ k + 1
    · have h1 := ih p w v hw hhead hlast hle
      have h2 : leO ((iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none) ((iterD g start k).getD v none) := by
        rw [hstep]
        exact bestAt_le_self g (iterD g start k) v
      exact leO_trans h2 h1
    · push_neg at hle
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := snoc_of_getLast p v hlast
      have hplen : p.length = q.length + 1 := by rw [hq]; simp
      obtain ⟨q', u, hq'⟩ : ∃ q' u, q = q' ++ [u] := by
        rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat q with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0] at hplen
          simp only [List.length_nil] at hplen
          omega
        · exact h0
      have hp2 : p = q' ++ [u, v] := by rw [hq, hq']; simp
      have hlenv : p.length = (q' ++ [u]).length + 1 := by rw [hq, hq']; simp
      rw [hp2] at hw
      obtain ⟨w1, we, hw1, hedge, hwe⟩ := (phw_snoc g q' u v w).mp hw
      have hihu : leO ((iterD g start k).getD u none) (some w1) := by
        refine ih (q' ++ [u]) w1 u hw1 ?_ (by simp) (by omega)
        rw [hq, hq'] at hhead
        rw [head?_append_ne_nil _ _ (by simp)] at hhead
        exact hhead
      rw [hstep, hwe]
      exact leO_trans (bestAt_le_edge g (iterD g start k) u v we hedge) (addO_le hihu)

/-! ### reduction of walks to simple paths without negative cycles -/

theorem reduce_path (g : WeightedGraph) (hnc : ¬ g.has_negative_cycle) :
    ∀ (N : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int), p.length ≤ N → g.path_has_weight p w → p ≠ [] →
      ∃ q w', g.path_has_weight q w' ∧ w' ≤ w ∧ q.head? = p.head? ∧
        q.getLast? = p.getLast? ∧ q.Nodup := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro p w hlen _ hne
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons a t => simp at hlen
  | succ N ih =>
    intro p w hlen hw hne
    by_cases hnd : p.Nodup
    · exact ⟨p, w, hw, le_refl w, rfl, rfl, hnd⟩
    · obtain ⟨A, B, C, x, hp⟩ := dup_decomp p hnd
      rw [hp] at hw
      obtain ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, hww⟩ := (phw_append_mid g A x (B ++ x :: C) w).mp hw
      have h2' : g.path_has_weight ((x :: B) ++ x :: C) w2 := by simpa using h2
      obtain ⟨w3, w4, h3, h4, hw2⟩ := (phw_append_mid g (x :: B) x C w2).mp h2'
      have hw3 : 0 ≤ w3 := by
        by_contra hneg
        push_neg at hneg
        apply hnc
        refine ⟨(x :: B) ++ [x], w3, isPath_of_phw g _ w3 (by simp) h3, ?_, ?_, h3, hneg⟩
        · rw [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
          omega
        · rw [head?_append_ne_nil _ _ (by simp), getLast?_append_right _ _ (by simp)]
          simp
      have hred : g.path_has_weight (A ++ x :: C) (w1 + w4) :=
        (phw_append_mid g A x C _).mpr ⟨w1, w4, h1, h4, rfl⟩
      have e1 : p.length = A.length + ((B.length + (C.length + 1)) + 1) := by
        rw [hp, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons]
      have e2 : (A ++ x :: C).length = A.length + (C.length + 1) := by
        rw [List.length_append, List.length_cons]
      obtain ⟨q, w', hq, hle, hqh, hql, hqnd⟩ :=
        ih (A ++ x :: C) (w1 + w4) (by omega) hred (by simp)
      refine ⟨q, w', hq, by omega, ?_, ?_, hqnd⟩
      · rw [hqh, hp]
        cases A with
        | nil => simp
        | cons a A' => simp
      · rw [hql, hp]
        have el : (A ++ x :: C).getLast? = (x :: C).getLast? :=
          getLast?_append_right A (x :: C) (by simp)
        rw [el]
        have e3 : A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) = (A ++ (x :: B)) ++ (x :: C) := by simp
        rw [e3, getLast?_append_right _ _ (by simp)]

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if iterD graph start (graph.size - 1) = stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)) then
    some (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1))
  else
    none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bellman_ford_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) :
    bellman_ford_postcond graph start
      (bellman_ford graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hstart, hbnd⟩ := h_precond
  have hunfold : bellman_ford graph start ⟨hwf, hstart, hbnd⟩ =
      (if iterD graph start (graph.size - 1) =
          stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)) then
        some (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)) else none) := rfl
  rw [hunfold]
  by_cases hEq : iterD graph start (graph.size - 1) =
      stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1))
  · rw [if_pos hEq]
    have hstab : ∀ j, iterD graph start ((graph.size - 1) + j) =
        iterD graph start (graph.size - 1) := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ j ihj =>
        have hs : iterD graph start ((graph.size - 1) + (j + 1)) =
            stepD graph (iterD graph start ((graph.size - 1) + j)) := rfl
        rw [hs, ihj, ← hEq]
    have hall : ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat), graph.path_has_weight p w →
        p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some v →
        leO ((iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none) (some w) := by
      intro p w v hw hh hl
      have h := iterD_complete graph start hwf hstart ((graph.size - 1) + p.length) p w v hw hh hl
        (by omega)
      rwa [hstab p.length] at h
    refine ⟨iterD_length graph start _, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    cases hd : (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none with
    | none =>
      rintro ⟨p, hip, hh, hl⟩
      have hne : p ≠ [] := by
        intro hc
        rw [hc] at hh
        simp at hh
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := phw_of_isPath graph p hip
      have hbound := hall p w v hw hh hl
      rw [hd] at hbound
      exact leO_none_some hbound
    | some d =>
      constructor
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqh⟩ := iterD_sound graph start hstart (graph.size - 1) v d hv hd
        exact ⟨q ++ [v], isPath_of_phw graph _ d (by simp) hq, hqh, by simp, hq⟩
      · intro p w hip hh hl hw
        have hbound := hall p w v hw hh hl
        rw [hd, leO_some_some] at hbound
        omega
  · rw [if_neg hEq]
    by_contra hnc
    apply hEq
    refine list_ext_getD _ _ (by rw [iterD_length, stepD_length]) ?_
    intro v hv
    rw [iterD_length] at hv
    have hle1 : leO ((stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none)
        ((iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none) := by
      rw [stepD_getD _ _ v hv]
      exact bestAt_le_self _ _ _
    have hle2 : leO ((iterD graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none)
        ((stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none) := by
      cases hs : (stepD graph (iterD graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none with
      | none => exact leO_none_right _
      | some x =>
        have hs' : (iterD graph start ((graph.size - 1) + 1)).getD v none = some x := hs
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hqh⟩ :=
          iterD_sound graph start hstart ((graph.size - 1) + 1) v x hv hs'
        obtain ⟨q2, w', hq2, hle, hq2h, hq2l, hq2nd⟩ :=
          reduce_path graph hnc (q ++ [v]).length (q ++ [v]) x (le_refl _) hq (by simp)
        have hq2len : q2.length ≤ graph.size := by
          by_cases hsmall : q2.length ≤ 1
          · omega
          · refine nodup_length_le q2 graph.size hq2nd ?_
            exact phw_mem_lt graph hwf q2 w' hq2 (by omega)
        have hq2head : q2.head? = some start := by rw [hq2h]; exact hqh
        have hq2last : q2.getLast? = some v := by rw [hq2l]; simp
        have hcomp := iterD_complete graph start hwf hstart (graph.size - 1) q2 w' v hq2
          hq2head hq2last (by omega)
        refine leO_trans hcomp ?_
        rw [leO_some_some]
        exact hle
    exact leO_antisymm hle2 hle1
  -- !benchmark @end proof

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧

/-! ### Option Int as "Int with infinity" -/

def leO (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

theorem leO_none_right (a : Option Int) : leO a none := by
  intro y hy
  exact absurd hy (by simp)

theorem leO_some_some {x y : Int} : leO (some x) (some y) ↔ x ≤ y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h y rfl
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hz
    omega
  · intro h y' hy'
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hy'
    exact ⟨x, rfl, by omega⟩

theorem leO_none_some {y : Int} : ¬ leO none (some y) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := h y rfl
  simp at hx

theorem leO_refl (a : Option Int) : leO a a := by
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

theorem leO_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b c) : leO a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := h1 x hx
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_trans hzx hxy⟩

theorem leO_antisymm {a b : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b a) : a = b := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some y => exact absurd h1 leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact absurd h2 leO_none_some
    | some y =>
      rw [leO_some_some] at h1
      rw [leO_some_some] at h2
      have : x = y := le_antisymm h1 h2
      rw [this]

def minO (a b : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match a, b with
  | none, b => b
  | some x, none => some x
  | some x, some y => some (min x y)

theorem minO_le_left (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) a := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_none_right _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_refl _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some x)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_left x y

theorem minO_le_right (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_refl _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_none_right _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some y)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_right x y

theorem minO_cases (a b : Option Int) : minO a b = a ∨ minO a b = b := by
  cases a with
  | none => right; rfl
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => left; rfl
    | some y =>
      rcases le_total x y with h | h
      · left
        show some (min x y) = some x
        rw [min_eq_left h]
      · right
        show some (min x y) = some y
        rw [min_eq_right h]

def addO (a : Option Int) (w : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (x + w)

theorem addO_le {a : Option Int} {y w : Int} (h : leO a (some y)) :
    leO (addO a w) (some (y + w)) := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact absurd h leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    rw [leO_some_some] at h
    show leO (some (x + w)) (some (y + w))
    rw [leO_some_some]
    omega

theorem addO_some {a : Option Int} {w z : Int} (h : addO a w = some z) :
    ∃ x, a = some x ∧ z = x + w := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    have hc : (none : Option Int) = some z := h
    exact absurd hc (by simp)
  | some x =>
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hc : some (x + w) = some z := h
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hc
    omega

/-! ### folding a minimum -/

def foldMin (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  l.foldl (fun acc pr => minO acc (f pr)) init

theorem foldMin_cons (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (a : Nat × Int) (l : List (Nat × Int))
    (init : Option Int) : foldMin f (a :: l) init = foldMin f l (minO init (f a)) := rfl

theorem foldMin_le_init (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int), leO (foldMin f l init) init := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; exact leO_refl _
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    exact leO_trans (ih _) (minO_le_left _ _)

theorem foldMin_le_mem (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) (pr : Nat × Int), pr ∈ l →
      leO (foldMin f l init) (f pr) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init pr h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init pr h
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h2
    · subst h1
      exact leO_trans (foldMin_le_init f t _) (minO_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih _ pr h2

theorem foldMin_cases (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int),
      foldMin f l init = init ∨ ∃ pr, pr ∈ l ∧ foldMin f l init = f pr := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases ih (minO init (f a)) with h | ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
    · rcases minO_cases init (f a) with h2 | h2
      · left; rw [h, h2]
      · right; exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self _ _, by rw [h, h2]⟩
    · right; exact ⟨pr, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hpr, h⟩

/-! ### tabulation -/

def tab (f : Nat → Option Int) (i : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f i :: tab f (i + 1) k

theorem tab_length (f : Nat → Option Int) : ∀ (k i : Nat), (tab f i k).length = k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i
    show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).length = k + 1
    rw [List.length_cons, ih]

theorem tab_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (k i v : Nat), v < k → (tab f i k).getD v none = f (i + v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i v h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v h
    cases v with
    | zero =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD 0 none = f (i + 0)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ m =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD (m + 1) none = f (i + (m + 1))
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ, ih (i + 1) m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega

/-! ### list helpers -/

theorem my_eq_nil_or_concat {α : Type} : ∀ (l : List α), l = [] ∨ ∃ L b, l = L ++ [b] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    right
    rcases ih with h | ⟨L, b, h⟩
    · exact ⟨[], a, by rw [h]⟩
    · exact ⟨a :: L, b, by rw [h]; simp⟩

theorem snoc_of_getLast {α : Type} (l : List α) (v : α) (h : l.getLast? = some v) :
    ∃ q, l = q ++ [v] := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l with hn | ⟨L, b, hL⟩
  · rw [hn] at h; simp at h
  · rw [hL] at h
    simp only [List.getLast?_concat, Option.some.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨L, by rw [hL, h]⟩

theorem head?_append_ne_nil {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l1 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).head? = l1.head? := by
  cases l1 with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t => simp

theorem getLast?_append_right {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l2 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).getLast? = l2.getLast? := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l2 with h0 | ⟨q, v, hq⟩
  · exact absurd h0 h
  · subst hq
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    simp

theorem list_ext_getD : ∀ (l1 l2 : List (Option Int)), l1.length = l2.length →
    (∀ v, v < l1.length → l1.getD v none = l2.getD v none) → l1 = l2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro l2 hl _
    cases l2 with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t => simp at hl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 hl h
    cases l2 with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons b t2 =>
      have h0 := h 0 (by simp)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_zero] at h0

        omega

        have := h (v + 1) hv'
        rw [List.getD_cons_succ, List.getD_cons_succ] at this

    p.length ≤ n := by
  have hsub : p ⊆ List.range n := by
    intro x hx

    ∃ (A B C : List Nat) (x : Nat), p = A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) := by
  intro p

theorem phw_cons (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (u :: v :: rest) w ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge u v we ∧ g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) wr ∧ w = we + wr := Iff.rfl

  constructor

  · intro h; exact ⟨by simp, h⟩

    | nil => exact isPath_single g u

def inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filterMap
      (fun pr => if pr.1 = v then some (u, pr.2) else none)))

theorem arr_mem_toList {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr.toList ↔ a ∈ arr := by
  simp

theorem mem_inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v u : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u', hu', pr, hpr, hif⟩ := h
    by_cases hc : pr.1 = v
    · rw [if_pos hc] at hif
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hif
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hif
      subst h1
      exact ⟨hu', pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mp hpr, hc, h2⟩
    · rw [if_neg hc] at hif
      exact absurd hif (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, h2⟩
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨u, hu, pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mpr hpr, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos h1, h2]

def bestAt (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  foldMin (fun pr => addO (d.getD pr.1 none) pr.2) (inEdges g v) (d.getD v none)

def stepD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  tab (fun v => bestAt g d v) 0 g.size

def iterD (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => tab (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none) 0 g.size
  | k + 1 => stepD g (iterD g start k)

    (stepD g d).length = g.size := tab_length _ _ _

    ∀ k, (iterD g start k).length = g.size := by
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero => exact tab_length _ _ _
  | succ k => exact tab_length _ _ _

theorem stepD_getD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (stepD g d).getD v none = bestAt g d v := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => bestAt g d v) g.size 0 v hv
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

    (iterD g start 0).getD v none = (if v = start then some 0 else none) := by

  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

/-! ### Option Int as "Int with infinity" -/

def leO (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

theorem leO_none_right (a : Option Int) : leO a none := by
  intro y hy
  exact absurd hy (by simp)

theorem leO_some_some {x y : Int} : leO (some x) (some y) ↔ x ≤ y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h y rfl
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hz
    omega
  · intro h y' hy'
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hy'
    exact ⟨x, rfl, by omega⟩

theorem leO_none_some {y : Int} : ¬ leO none (some y) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := h y rfl
  simp at hx

theorem leO_refl (a : Option Int) : leO a a := by
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

theorem leO_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b c) : leO a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := h1 x hx
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_trans hzx hxy⟩

theorem leO_antisymm {a b : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b a) : a = b := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some y => exact absurd h1 leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact absurd h2 leO_none_some
    | some y =>
      rw [leO_some_some] at h1
      rw [leO_some_some] at h2
      have : x = y := le_antisymm h1 h2
      rw [this]

def minO (a b : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match a, b with
  | none, b => b
  | some x, none => some x
  | some x, some y => some (min x y)

theorem minO_le_left (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) a := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_none_right _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_refl _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some x)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_left x y

theorem minO_le_right (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_refl _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_none_right _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some y)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_right x y

theorem minO_cases (a b : Option Int) : minO a b = a ∨ minO a b = b := by
  cases a with
  | none => right; rfl
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => left; rfl
    | some y =>
      rcases le_total x y with h | h
      · left
        show some (min x y) = some x
        rw [min_eq_left h]
      · right
        show some (min x y) = some y
        rw [min_eq_right h]

def addO (a : Option Int) (w : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (x + w)

theorem addO_le {a : Option Int} {y w : Int} (h : leO a (some y)) :
    leO (addO a w) (some (y + w)) := by

  | none => exact absurd h leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    rw [leO_some_some] at h

    omega

def tab (f : Nat → Option Int) (i : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f i :: tab f (i + 1) k

theorem tab_length (f : Nat → Option Int) : ∀ (k i : Nat), (tab f i k).length = k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i
    show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).length = k + 1
    rw [List.length_cons, ih]

theorem tab_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (k i v : Nat), v < k → (tab f i k).getD v none = f (i + v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i v h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v h
    cases v with
    | zero =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD 0 none = f (i + 0)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ m =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD (m + 1) none = f (i + (m + 1))
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ, ih (i + 1) m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega

def inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=

      (fun pr => if pr.1 = v then some (u, pr.2) else none)))

theorem arr_mem_toList {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr.toList ↔ a ∈ arr := by
  simp

theorem mem_inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v u : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u', hu', pr, hpr, hif⟩ := h
    by_cases hc : pr.1 = v
    · rw [if_pos hc] at hif
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hif
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hif
      subst h1
      exact ⟨hu', pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mp hpr, hc, h2⟩
    · rw [if_neg hc] at hif
      exact absurd hif (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, h2⟩
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨u, hu, pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mpr hpr, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos h1, h2]

def stepD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  tab (fun v => bestAt g d v) 0 g.size

def iterD (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)

  | k + 1 => stepD g (iterD g start k)

    (stepD g d).getD v none = bestAt g d v := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => bestAt g d v) g.size 0 v hv

        (phw_append_mid g A x C _).mpr ⟨w1, w4, h1, h4, rfl⟩

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

/-! ### Option Int as "Int with infinity" -/

def leO (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

theorem leO_none_right (a : Option Int) : leO a none := by
  intro y hy
  exact absurd hy (by simp)

theorem leO_some_some {x y : Int} : leO (some x) (some y) ↔ x ≤ y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h y rfl
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hz
    omega
  · intro h y' hy'
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hy'
    exact ⟨x, rfl, by omega⟩

theorem leO_none_some {y : Int} : ¬ leO none (some y) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := h y rfl
  simp at hx

theorem leO_refl (a : Option Int) : leO a a := by
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

theorem leO_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b c) : leO a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := h1 x hx
  exact ⟨z, hz, le_trans hzx hxy⟩

theorem leO_antisymm {a b : Option Int} (h1 : leO a b) (h2 : leO b a) : a = b := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some y => exact absurd h1 leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact absurd h2 leO_none_some
    | some y =>
      rw [leO_some_some] at h1
      rw [leO_some_some] at h2
      have : x = y := le_antisymm h1 h2
      rw [this]

def minO (a b : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match a, b with
  | none, b => b
  | some x, none => some x
  | some x, some y => some (min x y)

theorem minO_le_left (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) a := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_none_right _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_refl _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some x)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_left x y

theorem minO_le_right (a b : Option Int) : leO (minO a b) b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact leO_refl _
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact leO_none_right _
    | some y =>
      show leO (some (min x y)) (some y)
      rw [leO_some_some]
      exact min_le_right x y

theorem minO_cases (a b : Option Int) : minO a b = a ∨ minO a b = b := by
  cases a with
  | none => right; rfl
  | some x =>
    cases b with
    | none => left; rfl
    | some y =>
      rcases le_total x y with h | h
      · left
        show some (min x y) = some x
        rw [min_eq_left h]
      · right
        show some (min x y) = some y
        rw [min_eq_right h]

def addO (a : Option Int) (w : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (x + w)

theorem addO_le {a : Option Int} {y w : Int} (h : leO a (some y)) :
    leO (addO a w) (some (y + w)) := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact absurd h leO_none_some
  | some x =>
    rw [leO_some_some] at h
    show leO (some (x + w)) (some (y + w))
    rw [leO_some_some]
    omega

theorem addO_some {a : Option Int} {w z : Int} (h : addO a w = some z) :
    ∃ x, a = some x ∧ z = x + w := by
  cases a with
  | none =>
    have hc : (none : Option Int) = some z := h
    exact absurd hc (by simp)
  | some x =>
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hc : some (x + w) = some z := h
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hc
    omega

/-! ### folding a minimum -/

def foldMin (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  l.foldl (fun acc pr => minO acc (f pr)) init

theorem foldMin_cons (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) (a : Nat × Int) (l : List (Nat × Int))
    (init : Option Int) : foldMin f (a :: l) init = foldMin f l (minO init (f a)) := rfl

theorem foldMin_le_init (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int), leO (foldMin f l init) init := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; exact leO_refl _
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    exact leO_trans (ih _) (minO_le_left _ _)

theorem foldMin_le_mem (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int) (pr : Nat × Int), pr ∈ l →
      leO (foldMin f l init) (f pr) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init pr h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init pr h
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h2
    · subst h1
      exact leO_trans (foldMin_le_init f t _) (minO_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih _ pr h2

theorem foldMin_cases (f : Nat × Int → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List (Nat × Int)) (init : Option Int),
      foldMin f l init = init ∨ ∃ pr, pr ∈ l ∧ foldMin f l init = f pr := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [foldMin_cons]
    rcases ih (minO init (f a)) with h | ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
    · rcases minO_cases init (f a) with h2 | h2
      · left; rw [h, h2]
      · right; exact ⟨a, by simp, by rw [h, h2]⟩
    · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], h⟩

def tab (f : Nat → Option Int) (i : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => f i :: tab f (i + 1) k

theorem tab_length (f : Nat → Option Int) : ∀ (k i : Nat), (tab f i k).length = k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i
    show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).length = k + 1
    rw [List.length_cons, ih]

theorem tab_getD (f : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (k i v : Nat), v < k → (tab f i k).getD v none = f (i + v) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro i v h; exact absurd h (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v h
    cases v with
    | zero =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD 0 none = f (i + 0)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ m =>
      show (f i :: tab f (i + 1) k).getD (m + 1) none = f (i + (m + 1))
      rw [List.getD_cons_succ, ih (i + 1) m (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega

/-! ### list helpers -/

theorem my_eq_nil_or_concat {α : Type} : ∀ (l : List α), l = [] ∨ ∃ L b, l = L ++ [b] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    right
    rcases ih with h | ⟨L, b, h⟩
    · exact ⟨[], a, by simp [h]⟩
    · exact ⟨a :: L, b, by rw [h]; simp⟩

theorem snoc_of_getLast {α : Type} (l : List α) (v : α) (h : l.getLast? = some v) :
    ∃ q, l = q ++ [v] := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l with hn | ⟨L, b, hL⟩
  · rw [hn] at h; simp at h
  · rw [hL] at h
    simp only [List.getLast?_concat, Option.some.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨L, by rw [hL, h]⟩

theorem head?_append_ne_nil {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l1 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).head? = l1.head? := by
  cases l1 with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t => simp

theorem getLast?_append_right {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l2 ≠ []) :
    (l1 ++ l2).getLast? = l2.getLast? := by
  rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat l2 with h0 | ⟨q, v, hq⟩
  · exact absurd h0 h
  · subst hq
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    simp

theorem list_ext_getD : ∀ (l1 l2 : List (Option Int)), l1.length = l2.length →
    (∀ v, v < l1.length → l1.getD v none = l2.getD v none) → l1 = l2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro l2 hl _
    cases l2 with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t => simp at hl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 hl h
    cases l2 with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons b t2 =>
      have h0 := h 0 (by simp)
      rw [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_zero] at h0
      subst h0
      have hlen : t.length = t2.length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
        omega
      have hrest : t = t2 := by
        refine ih t2 hlen ?_
        intro v hv
        have hv' : v + 1 < (a :: t).length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        have hx := h (v + 1) hv'
        rw [List.getD_cons_succ, List.getD_cons_succ] at hx
        exact hx
      rw [hrest]

theorem nodup_length_le (p : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hnd : p.Nodup) (hlt : ∀ x ∈ p, x < n) :
    p.length ≤ n := by
  have hsub : p ⊆ List.range n := by
    intro x hx
    exact List.mem_range.mpr (hlt x hx)
  have h := List.Subperm.length_le (List.subperm_of_subset hnd hsub)
  simpa using h

theorem dup_decomp : ∀ (p : List Nat), ¬ p.Nodup →
    ∃ (A B C : List Nat) (x : Nat), p = A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd List.nodup_nil h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    by_cases hat : a ∈ t
    · obtain ⟨B, C, hBC⟩ := List.append_of_mem hat
      exact ⟨[], B, C, a, by simp [hBC]⟩
    · have hnd : ¬ t.Nodup := by
        intro hc
        exact h (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hat, hc⟩)
      obtain ⟨A, B, C, x, hp⟩ := ih hnd
      exact ⟨a :: A, B, C, x, by simp [hp]⟩

/-! ### basic path facts -/

theorem phw_nil (g : WeightedGraph) (w : Int) : g.path_has_weight [] w ↔ w = 0 := Iff.rfl

theorem phw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight [x] w ↔ w = 0 := Iff.rfl

theorem phw_cons (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (u :: v :: rest) w ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge u v we ∧ g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) wr ∧ w = we + wr := Iff.rfl

theorem isPath_single (g : WeightedGraph) (x : Nat) : g.is_path [x] := ⟨by simp, trivial⟩

theorem isPath_cons_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) :
    g.is_path (u :: v :: rest) ↔ ((∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, h⟩; exact h
  · intro h; exact ⟨by simp, h⟩

theorem isPath_of_phw (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int),
    p ≠ [] → g.path_has_weight p w → g.is_path p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h _; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro w _ hw
    cases t with
    | nil => exact isPath_single g u
    | cons v rest =>
      rw [phw_cons] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, _⟩ := hw
      exact (isPath_cons_iff g u v rest).mpr ⟨⟨we, hedge⟩, ih wr (by simp) hrest⟩

theorem phw_of_isPath (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, (phw_nil g 0).mpr rfl⟩
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro hp
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl⟩
    | cons v rest =>
      obtain ⟨⟨we, hedge⟩, hrest⟩ := (isPath_cons_iff g u v rest).mp hp
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih hrest
      exact ⟨we + wr, (phw_cons g u v rest _).mpr ⟨we, wr, hedge, hwr, rfl⟩⟩

theorem phw_append_mid (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) (w : Int),
      g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ x :: l2) w ↔
        ∃ w1 w2, g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ [x]) w1 ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧
          w = w1 + w2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro x l2 w
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨0, w, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, h, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
      have hw1 : w1 = 0 := (phw_single g x w1).mp h1
      subst hw1
      have hz : (0 : Int) + w2 = w2 := by omega
      rw [hz]
      exact h2
  | cons a l1' ih =>
    intro x l2 w
    cases l1' with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        refine ⟨we, wr, ?_, hrest, hw⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw1⟩ := h1
        have hz : wr = 0 := (phw_single g x wr).mp hrest
        exact (phw_cons g a x l2 _).mpr ⟨we, w2, hedge, h2, by omega⟩
    | cons b l1'' =>
      have ihx : ∀ (ww : Int), g.path_has_weight (b :: (l1'' ++ x :: l2)) ww ↔
          ∃ w1 w2, g.path_has_weight (b :: (l1'' ++ [x])) w1 ∧
            g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧ ww = w1 + w2 := by
        intro ww
        have h := ih x l2 ww
        simpa only [List.cons_append] using h
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [ihx] at hrest
        obtain ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, hwr⟩ := hrest
        refine ⟨we + w1, w2, ?_, h2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a b (l1'' ++ [x]) _).mpr ⟨we, w1, hedge, h1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, w2, h1, h2, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw1⟩ := h1
        refine (phw_cons g a b (l1'' ++ x :: l2) _).mpr ⟨we, wr + w2, hedge, ?_, by omega⟩
        rw [ihx]
        exact ⟨wr, w2, hrest, h2, rfl⟩

theorem phw_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (u x : Nat) (w : Int),
    g.path_has_weight (q ++ [u, x]) w ↔
      ∃ w1 we, g.path_has_weight (q ++ [u]) w1 ∧ g.has_edge u x we ∧ w = w1 + we := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
    intro u x w
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [phw_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
      have hz : wr = 0 := (phw_single g x wr).mp hrest
      exact ⟨0, we, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl, hedge, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
      have hz : w1 = 0 := (phw_single g u w1).mp h1
      exact (phw_cons g u x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
  | cons a q' ih =>
    intro u x w
    cases q' with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [phw_cons] at hrest
        obtain ⟨we2, wr2, hedge2, hrest2, hw2⟩ := hrest
        have hz : wr2 = 0 := (phw_single g x wr2).mp hrest2
        refine ⟨we, we2, ?_, hedge2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a u [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g u 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we1, wr1, hedge1, hrest1, hw1⟩ := h1
        have hz : wr1 = 0 := (phw_single g u wr1).mp hrest1
        refine (phw_cons g a u [x] _).mpr ⟨we1, we, hedge1, ?_, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g u x [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (phw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by omega⟩
    | cons b q'' =>
      have ihx : ∀ (ww : Int), g.path_has_weight (b :: (q'' ++ [u, x])) ww ↔
          ∃ w1 we, g.path_has_weight (b :: (q'' ++ [u])) w1 ∧ g.has_edge u x we ∧
            ww = w1 + we := by
        intro ww
        have h := ih u x ww
        simpa only [List.cons_append] using h
      simp only [List.cons_append]
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [phw_cons] at h
        obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hw⟩ := h
        rw [ihx] at hrest
        obtain ⟨w1, we2, h1, hedge2, hwr⟩ := hrest
        refine ⟨we + w1, we2, ?_, hedge2, by omega⟩
        exact (phw_cons g a b (q'' ++ [u]) _).mpr ⟨we, w1, hedge, h1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨w1, we, h1, hedge, rfl⟩
        rw [phw_cons] at h1
        obtain ⟨we1, wr1, hedge1, hrest1, hw1⟩ := h1
        refine (phw_cons g a b (q'' ++ [u, x]) _).mpr ⟨we1, wr1 + we, hedge1, ?_, by omega⟩
        rw [ihx]
        exact ⟨wr1, we, hrest1, hedge, rfl⟩

theorem phw_mem_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), g.path_has_weight p w → 2 ≤ p.length →
      ∀ x ∈ p, x < g.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w _ h; simp at h
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro w hw hlen x hx
    cases t with
    | nil => exact absurd hlen (by simp)
    | cons v rest =>
      rw [phw_cons] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, _⟩ := hw
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hxu | hx'
      · rw [hxu]; exact hedge.1
      · cases rest with
        | nil =>
          have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx'
          rw [hxv]
          obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, hp1, hp2⟩ := hedge
          have hlt := (hwf u hu).1 pair hpair
          rw [hp1] at hlt
          exact hlt
        | cons c rest' =>
          exact ih wr hrest (by simp) x hx'

/-! ### the algorithm -/

def inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filterMap
      (fun pr => if pr.1 = v then some (u, pr.2) else none)))

theorem arr_mem_toList {α : Type} (a : α) (arr : Array α) : a ∈ arr.toList ↔ a ∈ arr := by
  simp

theorem mem_inEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (v u : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u', hu', pr, hpr, hif⟩ := h
    by_cases hc : pr.1 = v
    · rw [if_pos hc] at hif
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hif
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hif
      subst h1
      exact ⟨hu', pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mp hpr, hc, h2⟩
    · rw [if_neg hc] at hif
      exact absurd hif (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hu, pr, hpr, h1, h2⟩
    simp only [inEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨u, hu, pr, (arr_mem_toList pr _).mpr hpr, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos h1, h2]

def bestAt (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  foldMin (fun pr => addO (d.getD pr.1 none) pr.2) (inEdges g v) (d.getD v none)

def stepD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  tab (fun v => bestAt g d v) 0 g.size

def iterD (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => tab (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none) 0 g.size
  | k + 1 => stepD g (iterD g start k)

theorem stepD_length (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) :
    (stepD g d).length = g.size := tab_length _ _ _

theorem iterD_length (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ k, (iterD g start k).length = g.size := by
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero => exact tab_length _ _ _
  | succ k => exact tab_length _ _ _

theorem stepD_getD (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (stepD g d).getD v none = bestAt g d v := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => bestAt g d v) g.size 0 v hv
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

theorem iterD_zero_getD (g : WeightedGraph) (start v : Nat) (hv : v < g.size) :
    (iterD g start 0).getD v none = (if v = start then some 0 else none) := by
  have h := tab_getD (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none) g.size 0 v hv
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

theorem bestAt_le_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    leO (bestAt g d v) (d.getD v none) := foldMin_le_init _ _ _

theorem bestAt_le_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (u v : Nat) (w : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : leO (bestAt g d v) (addO (d.getD u none) w) := by
  have hmem : (u, w) ∈ inEdges g v := (mem_inEdges g v u w).mpr h
  exact foldMin_le_mem _ _ _ _ hmem

theorem bestAt_cases (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    bestAt g d v = d.getD v none ∨
      ∃ u w, g.has_edge u v w ∧ bestAt g d v = addO (d.getD u none) w := by
  rcases foldMin_cases (fun pr => addO (d.getD pr.1 none) pr.2) (inEdges g v)
      (d.getD v none) with h | ⟨pr, hpr, h⟩
  · left; exact h
  · right
    refine ⟨pr.1, pr.2, (mem_inEdges g v pr.1 pr.2).mp ?_, h⟩
    simpa using hpr

/-! ### soundness and completeness of the iteration -/

theorem iterD_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (x : Int), v < g.size → (iterD g start k).getD v none = some x →
      ∃ q, g.path_has_weight (q ++ [v]) x ∧ (q ++ [v]).head? = some start := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v x hv h
    rw [iterD_zero_getD g start v hv] at h
    by_cases hvs : v = start
    · rw [if_pos hvs] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      refine ⟨[], ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.nil_append]
        exact (phw_single g v x).mpr h.symm
      · simp [hvs]
    · rw [if_neg hvs] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v x hv h
    have hstep : (iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none = bestAt g (iterD g start k) v :=
      stepD_getD g (iterD g start k) v hv
    rw [hstep] at h
    rcases bestAt_cases g (iterD g start k) v with hc | ⟨u, w, hedge, hc⟩
    · rw [hc] at h
      exact ih v x hv h
    · rw [hc] at h
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := addO_some h
      have hu : u < g.size := hedge.1
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hhead⟩ := ih u y hu hy
      refine ⟨q ++ [u], ?_, ?_⟩
      · have heq : (q ++ [u]) ++ [v] = q ++ [u, v] := by simp
        rw [heq]
        exact (phw_snoc g q u v x).mpr ⟨y, w, hq, hedge, by omega⟩
      · rw [head?_append_ne_nil _ _ (by simp)]
        exact hhead

theorem iterD_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat),
      g.path_has_weight p w → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some v →
      p.length ≤ k + 1 → leO ((iterD g start k).getD v none) (some w) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p w v hw hhead hlast hlen
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd hhead (by simp)
    | cons a t =>
      cases t with
      | nil =>
        have ha : a = start := by simpa using hhead
        have hav : a = v := by simpa using hlast
        have hw0 : w = 0 := (phw_single g a w).mp hw
        have hvs : v = start := by omega
        rw [hvs, iterD_zero_getD g start start hstart, if_pos rfl, hw0]
        exact leO_refl _
      | cons b t' => exact absurd hlen (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p w v hw hhead hlast hlen
    have hv : v < g.size := by
      obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ := snoc_of_getLast p v hlast
      cases p with
      | nil => exact absurd hhead (by simp)
      | cons a t =>
        cases t with
        | nil =>
          have ha : a = start := by simpa using hhead
          have hav : a = v := by simpa using hlast
          omega
        | cons b t' =>
          refine phw_mem_lt g hwf _ w hw (by simp) v ?_
          rw [hq0]
          simp
    have hstep : (iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none = bestAt g (iterD g start k) v :=
      stepD_getD g (iterD g start k) v hv
    by_cases hle : p.length ≤ k + 1
    · have h1 := ih p w v hw hhead hlast hle
      have h2 : leO ((iterD g start (k + 1)).getD v none) ((iterD g start k).getD v none) := by
        rw [hstep]
        exact bestAt_le_self g (iterD g start k) v
      exact leO_trans h2 h1
    · push_neg at hle
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := snoc_of_getLast p v hlast
      have hplen : p.length = q.length + 1 := by rw [hq]; simp
      obtain ⟨q', u, hq'⟩ : ∃ q' u, q = q' ++ [u] := by
        rcases my_eq_nil_or_concat q with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0] at hplen
          simp only [List.length_nil] at hplen
          omega
        · exact h0
      have hp2 : p = q' ++ [u, v] := by rw [hq, hq']; simp
      have hlenv : p.length = (q' ++ [u]).length + 1 := by rw [hq, hq']; simp
      rw [hp2] at hw
      obtain ⟨w1, we, hw1, hedge, hwe⟩ := (phw_snoc g q' u v w).mp hw
      have hihu : leO ((iterD g start k).getD u none) (some w1) := by
        refine ih (q' ++ [u]) w1 u hw1 ?_ (by simp) (by omega)
        rw [hq, hq'] at hhead
        rw [head?_append_ne_nil _ _ (by simp)] at hhead
        exact hhead
      rw [hstep, hwe]
      exact leO_trans (bestAt_le_edge g (iterD g start k) u v we hedge) (addO_le hihu)
